messages:
Sam (Sales): Heads-up: CloudLedger wants an EU-only POC. Must ensure inference, embeddings, backups, and monitoring never leave EU. They also asked for a short runbook for failover tests and the subprocessor list. Can ops/presales/security/legal confirm?

Akash (Presales): Feasible. Options: Hosted+pinned with EU-control-plane opt-in, Dedicated, or Private. Need to know if they want active-active across two EU regions or single-primary with EU-only failover. Also confirm BYO-KMS (they mentioned Azure).

Ellie (Ops): We can disable cross-region replication for POC. Subprocessors CSV available (internal link). Default telemetry goes to US; we can enable EU partitions for Datadog/Sentry. Need Datadog org id and Key Vault URL for BYO-KMS.

Maya (Security): I'll draft a residency attestation and attach SOC2/ISO cert links. For POC we set telemetry_mode: eu-only and block nonessential outbound. Also can produce a redacted network flow diagram if auditors request.

Priya (Legal): We can provide the subprocessor list and a DPA excerpt. If they want contract language guaranteeing control-plane locality, Legal needs the exact clause. That may take ~3 business days.

Sam (Sales): They prefer active-active eu-west-1 + eu-central-1 and BYO Azure Key Vault in eu-north. Also want a quick test plan to prove no egress.

Akash (Presales): Proposed POC config snippet:

``
deployment: hosted-pinned
regions: [eu-west-1, eu-central-1]
replication: within-eu-only
control_plane: dedicated-eu (opt-in)
telemetry_mode: eu-only
kms: byo (azure-key-vault-eu-north)
failover: eu-only
```

Test plan: deploy, run synth inference+embeddings, capture netflow, disable primary region to force failover, verify flows remain in EU, collect logs.

ops-bot: Ticket PR-5150 created for eu-controlplane-optin. ETA 8 business days.

Ellie (Ops): Ops checklist for CloudLedger POC:
- Attach subprocessors CSV
- Disable cross-region replication for POC buckets
- Configure telemetry to EU partitions (need org IDs)
- Accept BYO-KMS details and bind roles
- Provision dedicated EU control plane (8 biz days)
Estimated POC uplift: +20-30%.

Maya (Security): I'll DM Sam the attestation draft. If CloudLedger wants the network diagram for auditors, ask and we will provide redacted version.

Priya (Legal): Once Sam posts requested clause text, I'll review and aim to sign off quickly.

Sam (Sales): I'll collect Datadog org id, Azure Key Vault URL, and the DP contact today and post here. Thanks everyone. Leaving thread open for updates. :pray:
